analysis.visual_description: On the board. The sheets as they were on Wednesday, the two margin-marks unenlarged, no new speech under either.
On the board. The vertical line in the margin of the pleasant speech. No words added beside it. The sheet for a parliament is still the blank one, face down at the side.
On the board. The pen capped. No new leaf begun. The sheet for a parliament is still the blank one, face down at the side.
